result_text:
The contributor tables and the recent-commits bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. Every contributor is now listed, and the "limited to N items" note is gone.

The changes are in two files in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`**: removed the `limit` variable, the `.limit(limit)` call on the table stream, and the "The list is limited to…" paragraph. This covers the all, recent, and bots tables; the teams pages go through the same method.
- **`ContributorListsSection.java`**: removed the `.limit(...)` call in `getBarsHtml`, so the bar chart has one bar per recently active contributor.

The ordering is unchanged. The `contributorsListLimit` getter and setting remain in `LandscapeConfiguration`, but nothing reads them in these paths now. The repositories report still uses its own limit, which I left alone because it isn't part of this task.

I ran `mvn -q -o -pl reports test`; it completed with no failures. I did not add a test for a landscape with more contributors than the limit, and I did not generate a report to inspect the HTML. Nothing is committed.
